_: Where the fleet's owner wants things. domain and repo: the fleet's name and its repository on its forge. people: each box owner's keys - their ssh keys are the box's admin login, their paper key gets a copy of the box's disk keys (box.json owner picks whose). allowanceGb: each member's storage allowance across every service and box. mailAliases: <alias>@domain forwarded to that member's confirmed address by the mail Worker (lowercase a-z0-9-, never a member's name; dropping one removes its rule). develops: this fleet develops Commonty itself, so it runs its own CI (needs when).
